retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Explicitly unmetered: no download traffic limit, no speed limit, no download-count limit, and shares download without login.

tooling: No official API. Community wrappers exist (lanzou uploader scripts, `lanzou-api` style repos); the browser upload form is the only documented path.
chaining: Unlimited total x 100 MB per object is the pure 'per-record unlimited' shape the brief asks about: 20 TiB = ~210k objects. Registration needs a mainland phone number, so chaining is bounded by SIM supply, not by quota.
